title: My profile | Kaderblick Docs

hero.heading: My profile
hero.lead: The profile contains eight tabs. Its header shows your picture, account, roles, profile completeness and—where available—titles, level, XP and user relationships.

body:
Open and use your profile

  1. Open User account in the top-right corner.
  2. Select Profile.
  3. Use the horizontal tab bar to open the required area. On small screens, swipe or scroll the bar sideways.
  4. Apply fields in Profile and Equipment with Save at the bottom. Cancel closes the dialog.
  5. Some switches, particularly notification categories, save immediately. The relevant page states this next to the control.

The profile header

  • Profile picture: Open the small edit button on the picture to manage the available image sources.
  • Title, level and XP: Select the level indicator to open your detailed breakdown.
  • Roles: The badges show the system roles assigned to your account.
  • Relationships: The chain icon opens existing player or coach relationships. If none exists, it takes you to the assignment request.
  • Completeness: A bar below the header shows how much profile information has been completed. Selectable missing items lead to the corresponding tab.

“Profile” tab

Name and contact details

First name, last name and email are required. Check a new email address carefully before saving because it belongs to your user account.

Body data

Height (cm) and weight (kg) accept numbers. Leave a field empty if you do not want to store that information.

Change password

The two password fields are located at the bottom of the Profile tab. Enter the same new password in New password and Confirm password. If both fields remain empty, saving does not change your password.

“Equipment” tab

  • Shirt: no entry or XS to XXL.
  • Shorts: no entry, XS to XXL or one of the offered waist/length combinations.
  • Training jacket: no entry or XS to XXL.
  • Socks: no entry or sizes 35–38, 39–42, 43–46 and 47–50.
  • Shoe size (EU): numeric field; half sizes are supported.

“Settings” tab

Language

Select System language or one of the offered languages. System language follows the language of your device or browser.

Theme

System follows the device setting. Light and Dark set a fixed appearance.

Push notifications

This section shows the detected push status. Depending on that status, you can enable push notifications, send a test notification or update the result with Check again.

Two-factor authentication

The status shows whether an authenticator app or email code is enabled. Enable 2FA starts setup. If the authenticator method is active, the number of remaining backup codes appears; you can create new backup codes or disable 2FA through the confirmation dialog.

Public holidays in the calendar

Enable Show public holidays, then choose the region whose holidays should appear in the calendar.

Hall of Fame

Show in Hall of Fame controls whether you appear in the public level ranking and as a title holder.

“Notifications” tab

Disabling a switch prevents both the in-app notification and push delivery for that category.

GroupCategories
CommunicationMessages, club news, feedback replies
Appointments and matchesYour attendance status, player responses, appointment changes, event cancellations, event reactivation, match reminders
TeamCar pools, ride booked, surveys, penalties and rewards, match videos
OtherSystem and administration notices

My reminders

Create reminders for upcoming appointments that still have no response. Select Weekly rule, One-off or Appointment-based. Set the interval and unit, decide whether accepted appointments should also trigger reminders and add another reminder if required. Apply these settings with Save reminders.

“API token” tab

You only need this tab when connecting an intended external application to Kaderblick. Generate token creates a personal key. Its complete value is shown only directly after creation; copy it only into the intended application. Regenerate replaces the previous token and Revoke invalidates it. Never include the token in messages or screenshots.

“Calendar” tab

Export Kaderblick calendars

Select Generate feed links. You can then add the offered personal, club or platform calendars to a calendar application. Renewing replaces the previous links; removing them makes those links stop working.

Connect an external calendar

Select Add calendar, enter a name and iCal address, then choose a colour. Connected calendars can be enabled, disabled, edited or removed individually.

Select appointment types

The event selection determines which offered appointment types are included in your personal calendar view.

“Absences” tab

This tab appears for each linked player profile. Select Add absence, enter the offered period and save. Existing periods appear in this section and can be changed using their available actions. Without a player relationship, the tab explains that no player profile is linked yet.

“Documents” tab

This tab shows documents for player profiles connected to your account. If you have several relationships, each player has a separate section. Use the offered upload action to add a required document. Without a player relationship, no player documents can be displayed here.
